title: La Banda · Three Voices · Drummer Holds It Down 1
style: Latin rock and rap fusion. Features aggressive distorted electric guitar riffs, a driving drum kit with heavy snare and crash cymbals, and a prominent cowbell. The arrangement includes a live brass section with trumpets and trombones playing syncopated staccato stabs. Male vocals alternate between melodic rock singing and rhythmic Spanish rapping. The bass guitar follows a syncopated Latin-rock pattern. Tempo is 128 BPM in 4/4 time.
